result.summary: The home tab appears selected by the page content, but the bottom navigation highlights Profile instead of Home, which is a significant visual/state inconsistency.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows Profile as the selected tab (green icon and label) while the screen is clearly the Home feed with search, categories, and restaurant lists. Home is unselected.
issues.suggestion: Keep the selected tab in sync with the current screen: highlight Home when the home feed is shown, and only highlight Profile on the profile screen.
